notes.title: New Patch Available, introducing additional functionalities and general fixes!
notes.content:
A new update for #HotWheelsUnleashed is now available! Discover additional functionalities, fixes and new filters to easily find the best Tracks and Liveries created by the Community. 

Check it out: https://hotwheelsunleashed.com/game-updates

-Added some filters to the Community Tracks and Liveries.
-Added shortcuts to the Store and Collection in the “Hot Wheels City Rumble” menu.
-Improved UI for the “Add-ons” page.
-Added new functionalities to the news box in the main menu.
-Added support for the “Racing Season”.
-Fixed some bugs to improve stability.
-Minor fixes to the UI.
